status: experimental prototype; not a validated final method
scope: one-pass causal feedback; three raw-probability frames; optional observed odometry; fixed segmentation network
feedback: two past raw probabilities form persistent ROI using the prior BASE motion; current segmentation excluded; local intensity and gradient correspondence rerank separated subpixel motion peaks
strong_fusion: equal-weight arrived raw observations after selected-path alignment; invalid histories retain current probability; unchanged strong-current foreground protection
controls: B/C share conservative fusion; D/E/F share strong fusion and candidate set; ROI and uniform checks have the same full-array implementation and activation frames
default_selection: one predefined parameter set, no threshold or lambda search
evidence_limit: 3 source proxies / 12 existing training-source sequences; synthetic contracts are not real-rail accuracy; no final-test or real-time claim
